about_the_game:
The complete soundtrack for Burden of Truth, written and produced by Matt Enad, solo developer at RobProductions. Over 3 hours of original music were composed for the story sequences and investigations. This release contains the full versions of tracks created for cutscenes as well as the looping cross-examination music, trial segment background songs, and character themes. MP3 files are provided in addition to optional high-quality FLAC files.

This OST features a variety of moods and sounds that tie the story together. From the low-stakes ambient background songs that play during dialogue scenes to the intense cross-examination tracks, Burden of Truth's original music sets the stage for Conrad Cross' grand return to the courtroom. Many motifs and themes from the first Burden of Proof game, including the "objection", "discovery", "panic", and "situation" themes, have been reintegrated into the music and expanded upon to create a worthy successor to the original soundtrack!
